predictions.text: REAL reproduces XFER-1: the lower bound of benefit(REAL) is >= 50 reaches
Replay learning of the delivered episodes is not needed: REAL_NR is NON_INFERIOR to REAL
Saturated generic exposure (the upper bound) is NON_INFERIOR or EXCEEDS REAL_NR: the cold-start handicap, not real content, is the bottleneck
At matched budget the real placement matters: GEN_NR FALLS_SHORT of REAL_NR
Reversing the direction of travel destroys the benefit: REV_NR FALLS_SHORT of REAL_NR
The goal-entry term carries the unlock: ENTRY_NR is NON_INFERIOR to SAT_NR

verdict: A goal-free, experience-free saturated exposure reproduces or exceeds the real store's decision-time benefit: the benefit is removal of the cold-start goal-gradient attenuation, and correcting cold-start scoring dominates improving episodic memory. Even generic exposure of the same size reproduces it: real content adds nothing detectable. The goal-entering term alone carries the unlock (a one-term repair candidate).
